Raw / Ungraded (Unlimited): Typically sells between $100 and $215, depending on wear and surface condition on the holofoil.

Graded Copies: Values scale significantly higher for authenticated slabs, with mid-grades (PSA 6–7) going for $180–$300, and gem-mint PSA 10 copies reaching upwards of $3,700.
